about: plan-bound-audit.mjs allowlist (face Phase 14, ADR-1353). Every row is a write verb the audit could not show bound to a plan, with why. class: writer (IS the mechanism or derived output), lane-tool (not a face op; that lane's debt), door-gap (a face op the audit cannot prove bound; filed as its own /arc-change in initiatives/face/PROGRESS.md). Remove a row the day its verb becomes bound; the audit FAILs a row that names a verb now bound or gone.

verbs.why: IS the plan binding: the lock files it takes and the emit it is handed are the mechanism every bound verb calls
IS the one proposal-branch writer (ADR-1340): it writes a feat/face-* branch only when a bound caller (org-own, agent-scaffold, propose) hands it a plan already checked
IS the spine's storage: atomic append, lock, quarantine and idem index; every emit lands here
IS the spine writer (ADR-0031): it validates and appends what it is handed; the binding belongs to the caller that hands it
IS the decision writer: POST /api/decide stays byte-parity with it (ADR-1302); a decision answers a request the owner reads, it is not a plan
the discover lane's spine adapter (SPINE-G): it hands events to the emitter; the discover verb carries the binding
the docs lane's narrative receipt writer (ADR-1514): called by narrative-verify, whose row carries the binding
a generator: its output is a tracked file that CI regenerates with --check and fails on any drift, so the PR diff is the plan the owner reads
